title: Applicability of Directions
description: The provisions of these Directions shall apply to every entity regulated by Reserve Bank of India, more specifically as defined in 3 (b) (xiv) below, except where specifically mentioned otherwise.
source_clause: The provisions of these Directions shall apply to every entity regulated by Reserve Bank of India, more specifically as defined in 3 (b) (xiv) below, except where specifically mentioned otherwise.

title: KYC/AML Standards for Branches/Subsidiaries Abroad
description: Branches/ subsidiaries of REs are required to adopt the more stringent regulation of the two i.e., standards prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India and the host country regulators.
source_clause: ii. in case there is a variance in KYC/AML standards prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India and the host country regulators, branches/ subsidiaries of REs are required to adopt the more stringent regulation of the two.

title: Identification of Beneficial Owner
description: The beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical persons, has/have a controlling ownership interest or who exercise control through other means.
source_clause: iv. Beneficial Owner (BO) a. Where the customer is a company, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical persons, has/have a controlling ownership interest or who exercise control through other means.

title: Definition of Controlling Ownership Interest
description: Controlling ownership interest means ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of the shares or capital or profits of the company.
source_clause: “Controlling ownership interest” means ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of the shares or capital or profits of the company.

title: Certified Copy of Proof of Possession of Aadhaar
description: Obtaining a certified copy by the RE shall mean comparing the copy of the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where offline verification cannot be carried out or officially valid document so produced by the customer with the original and recording the same on the copy by the authorised officer of the RE.
source_clause: 10“Certified Copy” - Obtaining a certified copy by the RE shall mean comparing the copy of the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where offline verification cannot be carried out or officially valid document so produced by the customer with the original and recording the same on the copy by the authorised officer of the RE as per the provisions contained in the Act.

title: Officially Valid Document (OVD)
description: Officially Valid Document (OVD) means the passport, the driving licence, proof of possession of Aadhaar number, the Voter's Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India, job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the State Government and letter issued by the National Population Register containing details of name and address.
source_clause: xiv. "Officially Valid Document" (OVD) means the passport, the driving licence, 17proof of possession of Aadhaar number, the Voter's Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India, job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the State Government and letter issued by the National Population Register containing details of name and address.

title: Submission of OVD with current address
description: The customer shall submit OVD with current address within a period of three months of submitting the documents specified at ‘b’ above.
source_clause: c. the customer shall submit OVD with current address within a period of three months of submitting the documents specified at ‘b’ above

title: Definition of Suspicious transaction
description: A suspicious transaction means a transaction as defined below, including an attempted transaction, whether or not made in cash, which, to a person acting in good faith: gives rise to a reasonable ground of suspicion that it may involve proceeds of an offence specified in the Schedule to the Act, regardless of the value involved; or appears to be made in circumstances of unusual or unjustified complexity; or appears to not have economic rationale or bona-fide purpose; or gives rise to a reasonable ground of suspicion that it may involve financing of the activities relating to terrorism.
source_clause: gives rise to a reasonable ground of suspicion that it may involve proceeds of an offence specified in the Schedule to the Act, regardless of the value involved; or appears to be made in circumstances of unusual or unjustified complexity; or appears to not have economic rationale or bona-fide purpose; or gives rise to a reasonable ground of suspicion that it may involve financing of the activities relating to terrorism.

title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
description: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) means identifying and verifying the customer and the beneficial owner using reliable and independent sources of identification.
source_clause: v. 24“Customer Due Diligence (CDD)” means identifying and verifying the customer and the beneficial owner using reliable and independent sources of identification.

title: On-going Due Diligence
description: On-going Due Diligence means regular monitoring of transactions in accounts to ensure that those are consistent with RE’s knowledge about the customers, customers’ business and risk profile, the source of funds / wealth.
source_clause: xi. 25“On-going Due Diligence” means regular monitoring of transactions in accounts to ensure that those are consistent with RE’s knowledge about the customers, customers’ business and risk profile, the source of funds / wealth.

title: KYC Policy Approval
description: REs shall have a Know Your Customer (KYC) policy duly approved by the Board of Directors or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.
source_clause: 4. (a) There shall be a Know Your Customer (KYC) policy duly approved by the Board of Directors of REs or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.

title: Group-wide Policies for AML and CFT
description: REs which are part of a group shall implement group-wide policies for sharing information required for the purposes of client due diligence and money laundering and terror finance risk management.
source_clause: 32(b) In terms of PML Rules, groups are required to implement group-wide policies for the purpose of discharging obligations under the provisions of Chapter IV of the PML Act, 2002.

title: Risk Assessment
description: REs shall carry out a 'Money Laundering (ML) and Terrorist Financing (TF) Risk Assessment' exercise periodically to identify, assess and take effective measures to mitigate its money laundering and terrorist financing risk.
source_clause: REs shall carry out ‘Money Laundering (ML) and Terrorist Financing (TF) Risk Assessment’ exercise periodically to identify, assess and take effective measures to mitigate its money laundering and terrorist financing risk for clients, countries or geographic areas, products, services, transactions or delivery channels, etc.

title: Risk-Based Approach
description: REs shall apply a Risk Based Approach (RBA) for mitigation and management of the risks and have Board approved policies, controls and procedures in this regard.
source_clause: 35B. REs shall apply a Risk Based Approach (RBA) for mitigation and management of the risks (identified on their own or through national risk assessment) and should have Board approved policies, controls and procedures in this regard.

title: Designated Director
description: A 'Designated Director' shall be designated by the RE to ensure overall compliance with the obligations imposed under Chapter IV of the PML Act and the Rules.
source_clause: A “Designated Director” means a person designated by the RE to ensure overall compliance with the obligations imposed under Chapter IV of the PML Act and the Rules and shall be nominated by the Board.

title: Principal Officer
description: The Principal Officer shall be responsible for ensuring compliance, monitoring transactions, and sharing and reporting information as required under the law/regulations.
source_clause: The Principal Officer shall be responsible for ensuring compliance, monitoring transactions, and sharing and reporting information as required under the law/regulations.

title: Non- Outsourcing of Decision-Making Functions
description: REs shall ensure that decision-making functions of determining compliance with KYC norms are not outsourced.
source_clause: REs shall ensure that decision-making functions of determining compliance with KYC norms are not outsourced.

title: No account in anonymous or fictitious name
description: No account is opened in anonymous or fictitious/benami name.
source_clause: (a) No account is opened in anonymous or fictitious/benami name.

title: CDD measures for all customers
description: No account is opened where the RE is unable to apply appropriate CDD measures.
source_clause: No account is opened where the RE is unable to apply appropriate CDD measures, either due to non-cooperation of the customer or non-reliability of the documents/information furnished by the customer.

title: CDD procedure for all transactions
description: No transaction or account-based relationship is undertaken without following the CDD procedure.
source_clause: No transaction or account-based relationship is undertaken without following the CDD procedure.

title: KYC information for account opening
description: The mandatory information to be sought for KYC purpose while opening an account and during the periodic updation, is specified.
source_clause: The mandatory information to be sought for KYC purpose while opening an account and during the periodic updation, is specified.

title: Additional information with customer consent
description: Additional information, where such information requirement has not been specified in the internal KYC Policy of the RE, is obtained with the explicit consent of the customer.
source_clause: (e) Additional information, where such information requirement has not been specified in the internal KYC Policy of the RE, is obtained with the explicit consent of the customer.

title: CDD procedure at UCIC level
description: REs shall apply the CDD procedure at the UCIC level.
source_clause: 40 REs shall apply the CDD procedure at the UCIC level.

title: CDD for joint account holders
description: CDD Procedure is followed for all the joint account holders, while opening a joint account.
source_clause: (g) CDD Procedure is followed for all the joint account holders, while opening a joint account.

title: Circumstances for acting on behalf of another person
description: Circumstances in which, a customer is permitted to act on behalf of another person/entity, is clearly spelt out.
source_clause: (h) Circumstances in which, a customer is permitted to act on behalf of another person/entity, is clearly spelt out.

title: Sanctions list check
description: Suitable system is put in place to ensure that the identity of the customer does not match with any person or entity, whose name appears in the sanctions lists indicated in Chapter IX of this MD.
source_clause: (i) Suitable system is put in place to ensure that the identity of the customer does not match with any person or entity, whose name appears in the sanctions lists indicated in Chapter IX of this MD.

title: PAN verification
description: Where Permanent Account Number (PAN) is obtained, the same shall be verified from the verification facility of the issuing authority.
source_clause: Where Permanent Account Number (PAN) is obtained, the same shall be verified from the verification facility of the issuing authority.

title: Digital signature verification
description: Where an equivalent e-document is obtained from the customer, RE shall verify the digital signature as per the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000).
source_clause: (k) 43Where an equivalent e-document is obtained from the customer, RE shall verify the digital signature as per the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000).

title: GST details verification
description: Where Goods and Services Tax (GST) details are available, the GST number shall be verified from the search/verification facility of the issuing authority.
source_clause: (l) 44Where Goods and Services Tax (GST) details are available, the GST number shall be verified from the search/verification facility of the issuing authority.

title: No denial of banking facility
description: Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of banking/financial facility to members of the general public, especially those, who are financially or socially disadvantaged, including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).
source_clause: 11. Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of banking/financial facility to members of the general public, especially those, who are financially or socially disadvantaged,  including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

title: Reason for rejection of application
description: No application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC shall be rejected without application of mind. Reason(s) of rejection shall be duly recorded by the officer concerned.
source_clause: No application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC shall be rejected without application of mind. Reason(s) of rejection shall be duly recorded by the officer concerned.

title: Suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing
description: Where RE forms a suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, and it reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip-off the customer, it shall not pursue the CDD process, and instead file an STR with FIU-IND.
source_clause: 11A. Where RE forms a suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, and it reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip-off the customer, it shall not pursue the CDD process, and instead file an STR with FIU-IND.

title: Risk-based approach
description: For Risk Management, REs shall have a risk-based approach which includes categorisation of customers as low, medium and high-risk category.
source_clause: 12. For Risk Management, REs shall have a risk-based approach which includes the following.

title: Risk categorisation
description: Risk categorisation shall be undertaken based on parameters such as customer’s identity, social/financial status, nature of business activity, and information about the customer’s business and their location.
source_clause: (c) Risk categorisation shall be undertaken based on parameters such as customer’s identity, social/financial status, nature of business activity, and information about the customer’s business and their location,

title: Confidentiality of risk categorisation
description: The risk categorisation of a customer and the specific reasons for such categorisation shall be kept confidential and shall not be revealed to the customer.
source_clause: The risk categorisation of a customer and the specific reasons for such categorisation shall be kept confidential and shall not be revealed to the customer to avoid tipping off the customer.

title: Identification of customers
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers in specified cases, including commencement of an account-based relationship.
source_clause: 13. REs shall undertake identification of customers in the following cases:

title: International money transfer operations
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers for international money transfer operations for a person who is not an account holder of the RE.
source_clause: (b) Carrying out any international money transfer operations for a person who is not an account holder of the RE.

title: Doubt about authenticity or adequacy of customer identification
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers when there is a doubt about the authenticity or adequacy of the customer identification data it has obtained.
source_clause: When there is a doubt about the authenticity or adequacy of the customer identification data it has obtained.

title: Third-party products and transactions
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers when selling third-party products as agents, selling their own products, payment of dues of credit cards/sale and reloading of prepaid/travel cards and any other product for more than rupees fifty thousand.
source_clause: Selling third party products as agents, selling their own products, payment of dues of credit cards/sale and reloading of prepaid/travel cards and any other product for more than rupees fifty thousand.

title: Non-account-based customer transactions
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers for non-account-based customer transactions where the amount involved is equal to or exceeds rupees fifty thousand.
source_clause: Carrying out transactions for a non-account-based customer, that is a walk-in customer, where the amount involved is equal to or exceeds rupees fifty thousand, whether conducted as a single transaction or several transactions that appear to be connected.

title: Structuring transactions
description: REs shall undertake identification of customers when a RE has reason to believe that a customer (account-based or walk-in) is intentionally structuring a transaction into a series of transactions below the threshold of rupees fifty thousand.
source_clause: (f) When a RE has reason to believe that a customer (account- based or walk-in) is intentionally structuring a transaction into a series of transactions below the threshold of rupees fifty thousand.

title: Reliance on third-party due diligence
description: REs may rely on customer due diligence done by a third party, subject to specified conditions.
source_clause: 14. For the purpose of verifying the identity of customers at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or while carrying out occasional transaction of an amount equal to or exceeding rupees fifty thousand, whether conducted as a single transaction or several transactions that appear to be connected, or any international money transfer operations, REs, shall at their option, rely on customer due diligence done by a third party, subject to the following conditions:

title: CDD for individuals
description: For undertaking CDD, REs shall obtain specified documents from an individual while establishing an account-based relationship or while dealing with the individual who is a beneficial owner, authorised signatory or the power of attorney holder related to any legal entity.
source_clause: For undertaking CDD, REs shall obtain the following from an individual while establishing an account-based relationship or while dealing with the individual who is a beneficial owner, authorised signatory or the power of attorney holder related to any legal entity:

title: Exception Handling for CDD
description: REs shall ensure to duly record the cases of exception handling in a centralised exception database. The database shall contain the details of grounds of granting exception, customer details, name of the designated official authorising the exception and additional details, if any.
source_clause: CDD done in this manner shall invariably be carried out by an official of the RE and such exception handling shall also be a part of the concurrent audit as mandated in paragraph 8. REs shall ensure to duly record the cases of exception handling in a centralised exception database.

title: Aadhaar Number Redaction
description: RE shall, where its customer submits a proof of possession of Aadhaar Number containing Aadhaar Number, ensure that such customer redacts or blacks out his Aadhaar number through appropriate means where the authentication of Aadhaar number is not required.
source_clause: Explanation 1: RE shall, where its customer submits a proof of possession of Aadhaar Number containing Aadhaar Number, ensure that such customer redacts or blacks out his Aadhaar number through appropriate means where the authentication of Aadhaar number is not required as per proviso (i) above.

title: OTP-Based e-KYC Conditions
description: Accounts opened using Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC, in non-face-to-face mode, are subject to the following conditions: (i) There must be a specific consent from the customer for authentication through OTP. (ii) Transaction alerts, OTP, etc., are sent only to the mobile number of the customer registered with Aadhaar. (iii) The aggregate balance of all the deposit accounts of the customer shall not exceed rupees one lakh.
source_clause: 17. Accounts opened using Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC, in non-face-to-face mode, are subject to the following conditions: i. There must be a specific consent from the customer for authentication through OTP. ii. 59As a risk-mitigating measure for such accounts, REs shall ensure that transaction alerts, OTP, etc., are sent only to the mobile number of the customer registered with Aadhaar. iii. The aggregate balance of all the deposit accounts of the customer shall not exceed rupees one lakh.

title: V-CIP Infrastructure Requirements
description: REs opting to undertake V-CIP, shall adhere to the following minimum standards: (a) V-CIP Infrastructure (i) The RE should have complied with the RBI guidelines on minimum baseline cyber security and resilience framework for banks, as updated from time to time.
source_clause: REs opting to undertake V-CIP, shall adhere to the following minimum standards:  (a) V-CIP Infrastructure  i) The RE should have complied with the RBI guidelines on minimum baseline cyber security and resilience framework for banks, as updated from time to time

title: V-CIP Procedure Requirements
description: Each RE shall formulate a clear work flow and standard operating procedure for V-CIP and ensure adherence to it. The V-CIP process shall be operated only by officials of the RE specially trained for this purpose.
source_clause: Each RE shall formulate a clear work flow and standard operating procedure for V-CIP and ensure adherence to it. The V-CIP process shall be operated only by officials of the RE specially trained for this purpose.

title: Aadhaar XML File or QR Code Validity
description: In case of offline verification of Aadhaar using XML file or Aadhaar Secure QR Code, it shall be ensured that the XML file or QR code generation date is not older than three working days from the date of carrying out V-CIP.
source_clause: 68In case of offline verification of Aadhaar using XML file or Aadhaar Secure QR Code, it shall be ensured that the XML file or QR code generation date is not older than three working days from the date of carrying out V-CIP.

title: Verify Customer Address
description: If the address of the customer is different from that indicated in the OVD, suitable records of the current address shall be captured.
source_clause: vii) If the address of the customer is different from that indicated in the OVD, suitable records of the current address shall be captured, as per the existing requirement.

title: Capture PAN Card Image
description: RE shall capture a clear image of PAN card to be displayed by the customer during the process, except in cases where e-PAN is provided by the customer.
source_clause: viii) RE shall capture a clear image of PAN card to be displayed by the customer during the process, except in cases where e-PAN is provided by the customer.

title: Verify PAN Details
description: The PAN details shall be verified from the database of the issuing authority including through DigiLocker.
source_clause: viii) RE shall capture a clear image of PAN card to be displayed by the customer during the process, except in cases where e-PAN is provided by the customer. The PAN details shall be verified from the database of the issuing authority including through DigiLocker.

title: Match Customer Details
description: The authorised official of the RE shall ensure that photograph of the customer in the Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN matches with the customer undertaking the V-CIP and the identification details in Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN shall match with the details provided by the customer.
source_clause: x) The authorised official of the RE shall ensure that photograph of the customer in the Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN matches with the customer undertaking the V-CIP and the identification details in Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN shall match with the details provided by the customer.

title: Store V-CIP Records
description: The entire data and recordings of V-CIP shall be stored in a system / systems located in India.
source_clause: i) The entire data and recordings of V-CIP shall be stored in a system / systems located in India.

title: Limit Small Account Transactions
description: Balances in all their accounts taken together shall not exceed rupees fifty thousand at any point of time.
source_clause: (d) Balances in all their accounts taken together shall not exceed rupees fifty thousand at any point of time.

title: Limit Small Account Credits
description: The total credit in all the accounts taken together shall not exceed rupees one lakh in a year.
source_clause: The total credit in all the accounts taken together shall not exceed rupees one lakh in a year.

title: Monitor Small Accounts
description: The account shall be monitored and when there is suspicion of money laundering or financing of terrorism activities or other high-risk scenarios, the identity of the customer shall be established.
source_clause: (h) The account shall be monitored and when there is suspicion of money laundering or financing of terrorism activities or other high-risk scenarios, the identity of the customer shall be established as per paragraph 16 or paragraph 18.

title: Documentation for Partnership Firm Account Opening
description: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof shall be obtained: Registration certificate, Partnership deed, Permanent Account Number of the partnership firm, Documents relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees holding an attorney to transact on its behalf, Names of all the partners, and Address of the registered office and the principal place of its business.
source_clause: 31. 93For opening an account of a partnership firm, the certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof shall be obtained: (a) Registration certificate (b) Partnership deed (c) 94Permanent Account Number of the partnership firm  (d) 95Documents, as specified in paragraph 16, relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees, as the case may be, holding an attorney to transact on its behalf  (e) 96the names of all the partners and  (f) 97address of the registered office, and the principal place of its business, if it is different.

title: Documentation for Unincorporated Association or Body of Individuals Account Opening
description: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof shall be obtained: Resolution of the managing body, Permanent Account Number or Form No. 60, Power of attorney granted to transact on its behalf, Documents relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees holding an attorney to transact on its behalf, and Such information as may be required by the RE to collectively establish the legal existence of such an association or body of individuals.
source_clause: 33A. 104For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof shall be obtained: (a) Resolution of the managing body of such association or body of individuals (b) 105Permanent Account Number or Form No. 60 of the unincorporated association or a body of individuals (c) Power of attorney granted to transact on its behalf (d) 106Documents, as specified in paragraph 16, relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees, as the case may be, holding an attorney to transact on its behalf and (e) Such information as may be required by the RE to collectively establish the legal existence of such an association or body of individuals.

title: Ongoing Due Diligence
description: REs shall undertake on-going due diligence of customers to ensure that their transactions are consistent with their knowledge about the customers, customers’ business and risk profile, the source of funds / wealth.
source_clause: 35. 110REs shall undertake on-going due diligence of customers to ensure that their transactions are consistent with their knowledge about the customers, customers’ business and risk profile, the source of funds / wealth.

title: KYC Updation
description: REs shall adopt a risk-based approach for periodic updation of KYC ensuring that the information or data collected under CDD is kept up-to-date and relevant, particularly where there is high risk. Periodic updation shall be carried out at least once in every two years for high-risk customers, once in every eight years for medium risk customers and once in every ten years for low-risk customers.
source_clause: REs shall adopt a risk-based approach for periodic updation of KYC ensuring that the information or data collected under CDD is kept up-to-date and relevant, particularly where there is high risk.

title: Beneficial Owner Identification
description: For opening an account of a Legal Person who is not a natural person, the beneficial owner(s) shall be identified and all reasonable steps in terms of sub-rule (3) of Rule 9 of the Rules to verify his/her identity shall be undertaken.
source_clause: 34. For opening an account of a Legal Person who is not a natural person, the beneficial owner(s) shall be identified and all reasonable steps in terms of sub-rule (3) of Rule 9 of the Rules to verify his/her identity shall be undertaken keeping in view the following:

title: Trustee Disclosure
description: In case of a trust, the RE shall ensure that trustees disclose their status at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or when carrying out transactions.
source_clause: 108Provided that in case of a trust, the RE shall ensure that trustees disclose their status at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or when carrying out transactions as specified in clauses (b), (e) and (f) of paragraph 13 of this MD.

title: Use of Business Correspondent for KYC Updation
description: Banks can use Business Correspondents (BCs) to obtain self-declarations from customers for KYC updation. The BC shall authenticate the self-declaration and supporting documents and forward them to the bank.
source_clause: The bank shall enable its BC systems for recording these self-declarations and supporting documents thereof in electronic form in the bank’s systems.

title: KYC Updation through Aadhaar OTP
description: Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC can be used for KYC updation in non-face-to-face mode. Conditions stipulated in paragraph 17 are not applicable in this case.
source_clause: Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC in non-face to face mode may be used for updation/ periodic updation.

title: Self-Declaration for Non-Individual Customers
description: In case of no change in KYC information of a non-individual customer, a self-declaration shall be obtained through email, ATMs, digital channels, letter, or board resolution.
source_clause: In case of no change in the KYC information of the LE customer, a self-declaration in this regard shall be obtained from the LE customer through its email id registered with the RE, ATMs, digital channels (such as online banking / internet banking, mobile application of RE), letter from an official authorized by the LE in this regard, board resolution, etc.

title: KYC Document Validation
description: REs shall ensure that KYC documents of customers are available and valid as per current CDD standards.
source_clause: The KYC documents of the customer as per the current CDD standards are available with them.

title: PAN Verification
description: REs shall verify PAN details of customers from the database of the issuing authority at the time of periodic updation of KYC.
source_clause: Customer’s PAN details, if available with the RE, is verified from the database of the issuing authority at the time of periodic updation of KYC.

title: Acknowledgment for KYC Updation
description: REs shall provide acknowledgment to customers mentioning the date of receipt of relevant documents for KYC updation.
source_clause: Acknowledgment is provided to the customer mentioning the date of receipt of the relevant document(s), including self-declaration from the customer, for carrying out updation/ periodic updation.

title: KYC Updation Intimation
description: REs shall intimate customers in advance to update their KYC and provide at least three advance intimations and three reminders.
source_clause: The RE shall intimate its customers, in advance, to update their KYC.  Prior to the due date of periodic updation of KYC, the RE shall give at least three advance intimations, including at least one intimation by letter, at appropriate intervals to its customers through available communication options/ channels for complying with the requirement of periodic updation of KYC.

title: Enhanced Due Diligence for Non-Face-to-Face Customer Onboarding
description: REs shall undertake enhanced due diligence measures for non-face-to-face customer onboarding, including V-CIP, mobile number verification, and address verification.
source_clause: Following EDD measures shall be undertaken by REs for non-face-to-face customer onboarding (other than customer onboarding in terms of paragraph 17):

title: High-Risk Customer Categorization
description: Customers who are not identified in a face-to-face manner shall be categorized as high-risk customers and accounts opened in non-face-to-face mode shall be subjected to enhanced monitoring until the identity of the customer is verified in face-to-face manner or through V-CIP.
source_clause: f) Such customers shall be categorized as high-risk customers and accounts opened in non-face to face mode shall be subjected to enhanced monitoring until the identity of the customer is verified in face-to-face manner or through V-CIP.

title: PEP Account Opening Requirements
description: REs shall have in place appropriate risk management systems to determine whether the customer or the beneficial owner is a PEP; take reasonable measures for establishing the source of funds/wealth; obtain senior management approval to open an account for a PEP; and subject such accounts to enhanced monitoring on an on-going basis.
source_clause: A. REs shall have the option of establishing a relationship with PEPs (whether as customer or beneficial owner) provided that, apart from performing normal customer due diligence: (a) REs have in place appropriate risk management systems to determine whether the customer or the beneficial owner is a PEP; (b) Reasonable measures are taken by the REs for establishing the source of funds / wealth;  (c) the approval to open an account for a PEP shall be obtained from the senior management;  (d) all such accounts are subjected to enhanced monitoring on an on-going basis;

title: Record Management Requirements
description: REs shall maintain all necessary records of transactions between the RE and the customer, both domestic and international, for at least five years from the date of transaction; preserve records pertaining to the identification of the customers and their addresses for at least five years after the business relationship is ended; and make available swiftly the identification records and transaction data to the competent authorities upon request.
source_clause: 46. 131The following steps shall be taken regarding maintenance, preservation and reporting of customer information, with reference to provisions of PML Act and Rules. REs shall, (a) maintain all necessary records of transactions between the RE and the customer, both domestic and international, for at least five years from the date of transaction;  (b) preserve the records pertaining to the identification of the customers and their addresses obtained while opening the account and during the course of business relationship, for at least five years after the business relationship is ended;   (c) 132make available swiftly, the identification records and transaction data to the competent authorities upon request;

title: Reporting Requirements to FIU-IND
description: REs shall furnish to the Director, Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), information referred to in rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 in terms of rule 7 thereof.
source_clause: 47. REs shall furnish to the Director, Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), information referred to in rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 in terms of rule 7 thereof.

title: Suspicious Transaction Reporting
description: REs shall put in use robust software, throwing alerts when the transactions are inconsistent with risk categorization and updated profile of the customers, as a part of effective identification and reporting of suspicious transactions.
source_clause: Robust software, throwing alerts when the transactions are inconsistent with risk categorization and updated profile of the customers shall be put in to use as a part of effective identification and reporting of suspicious transactions.

title: Screening against UNSC Sanctions Lists
description: REs shall ensure that they do not have any account in the name of individuals/entities appearing in the UNSC Sanctions Lists, which are approved by and periodically circulated by the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).
source_clause: (a) REs shall ensure that in terms of section 51A of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) (UAPA) Act, 1967 and amendments thereto, they do not have any account in the name of individuals/entities appearing in the lists of individuals and entities, suspected of having terrorist links, which are approved by and periodically circulated by the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

title: Daily Verification of UNSC Sanctions Lists
description: REs shall verify the UNSC Sanctions Lists on a daily basis and take into account any modifications to the lists in terms of additions, deletions or other changes.
source_clause: The aforementioned lists, i.e., UNSC Sanctions Lists and lists as available in the Schedules to the Prevention and Suppression of Terrorism (Implementation of Security Council Resolutions) Order, 2007, as amended from time to time, shall be verified on daily basis and any modifications to the lists in terms of additions, deletions or other changes shall be taken into account by the REs for meticulous compliance.

title: Reporting of Accounts Resembling Listed Entities
description: REs shall report details of accounts resembling any of the individuals/entities in the lists to FIU-IND apart from advising Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) as required under UAPA notification dated February 2, 2021.
source_clause: (b) Details of accounts resembling any of the individuals/entities in the lists shall be reported to FIU-IND apart from advising Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) as required under UAPA notification dated 136February 2, 2021 (Annex II of this Master Direction).

title: Freezing of Assets under UAPA
description: REs shall strictly follow the procedure laid down in the UAPA Order dated February 2, 2021, for freezing of assets under section 51A of UAPA, 1967.
source_clause: (c) Freezing of Assets under section 51A of UAPA, 1967: The procedure laid down in the UAPA Order dated 137February 2, 2021 (Annex II of this Master Direction), shall be strictly followed and meticulous compliance with the Order issued by the Government shall be ensured.

title: Compliance with WMD Act, 2005
description: REs shall ensure meticulous compliance with the 'Procedure for Implementation of section 12A of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005' laid down in terms of section 12A of the WMD Act, 2005.
source_clause: REs shall ensure meticulous compliance with the 'Procedure for Implementation of section 12A of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005' laid down in terms of section 12A of the WMD Act, 2005 vide Order dated September 1, 2023, by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India (Annex III of this Master Direction).

title: Enhanced Due Diligence for FATF-Listed Jurisdictions
description: REs shall apply enhanced due diligence measures, which are effective and proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons (including financial institutions) from countries for which this is called for by the FATF.
source_clause: REs shall apply enhanced due diligence measures, which are effective and proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons (including financial institutions) from countries for which this is called for by the FATF.

title: Secrecy Obligations and Sharing of Information
description: REs shall maintain secrecy regarding the customer information which arises out of the contractual relationship between the RE and customer.
source_clause: (a) REs shall maintain secrecy regarding the customer information which arises out of the contractual relationship between the RE and customer.

title: Compliance with Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010
description: Banks shall ensure adherence to the provisions of Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010 and Rules made thereunder.
source_clause: Banks shall ensure adherence to the provisions of Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010 and Rules made thereunder.

title: KYC Records Upload
description: REs shall capture customer's KYC records and upload onto CKYCR within 10 days of commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.
source_clause: (b) In terms of provision of Rule 9(1A) of the PML Rules, the REs shall capture customer’s KYC records and upload onto CKYCR within 10 days of commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.

title: KYC Data Templates
description: REs shall capture the KYC information for sharing with the CKYCR in the manner mentioned in the Rules, as per the KYC templates prepared for ‘Individuals’ and ‘Legal Entities’ (LEs), as the case may be.
source_clause: (d) REs shall capture the KYC information for sharing with the CKYCR in the manner mentioned in the Rules, as per the KYC templates prepared for ‘Individuals’ and ‘Legal Entities’ (LEs), as the case may be.

title: KYC Identifier Generation
description: Once KYC Identifier is generated by CKYCR, REs shall ensure that the same is communicated to the individual/LE as the case may be.
source_clause: (g) Once KYC Identifier is generated by CKYCR, REs shall ensure that the same is communicated to the individual/LE as the case may be.

title: FATCA and CRS Registration
description: REs shall register on the related e-filling portal of Income Tax Department as Reporting Financial Institutions.
source_clause: (a) Register on the related e-filling portal of Income Tax Department as Reporting Financial Institutions at the link https://incometaxindiaefiling.gov.in/ post login -> My Account --> Register as Reporting Financial Institution,

title: FATCA and CRS Reporting
description: REs shall submit online reports by using the digital signature of the ‘Designated Director’ by either uploading the Form 61B or ‘NIL’ report.
source_clause: (b) is not present but similar text: "Under FATCA and CRS, REs shall adhere to the provisions of Income Tax Rules 114F, 114G and 114H and determine whether they are a Reporting Financial Institution as defined in Income Tax Rule 114F and if so, shall take following steps for complying with the reporting requirements:" does not match. However  'REs shall submit online reports by using the digital signature of the ‘Designated Director’ by either uploading the Form 61B or ‘NIL’ report' does not appear verbatim however similar text 'REs shall adhere to the provisions of Income Tax Rules 114F, 114G and 114H' appears

title: Payment Instrument Presentation
description: Payment of cheques/drafts/pay orders/banker’s cheques, if they are presented beyond the period of three months from the date of such instruments, shall not be made.
source_clause: Payment of cheques/drafts/pay orders/banker’s cheques, if they are presented beyond the period of three months from the date of such instruments, shall not be made.

title: Money Mules Operation
description: The instructions on opening of accounts and monitoring of transactions shall be strictly adhered to, in order to minimise the operations of “Money Mules”.
source_clause: The instructions on opening of accounts and monitoring of transactions shall be strictly adhered to, in order to minimise the operations of "Money Mules" which are used to launder the proceeds of fraud schemes (e.g., phishing and identity theft) by criminals who gain illegal access to deposit accounts by recruiting third parties which act as "money mules."

title: Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC)
description: A Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC) shall be allotted while entering into new relationships with individual customers as also the existing individual customers by REs.
source_clause: (a) 152A Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC) shall be allotted while entering into new relationships with individual customers as also the existing individual customers by REs.

title: Correspondent Banking Policy
description: Banks shall have a policy approved by their Boards, or by a committee headed by the Chairman/CEO/MD to lay down parameters for approving cross-border correspondent banking and other similar relationships.
source_clause: Banks shall have a policy approved by their Boards, or by a committee headed by the Chairman/CEO/MD to lay down parameters for approving cross-border correspondent banking and other similar relationships.

title: KYC/AML Policies for Respondent Banks
description: Banks shall ensure that respondent banks have KYC/AML policies and procedures in place and apply enhanced 'due diligence' procedures for transactions carried out through the correspondent accounts.
source_clause: (j) Banks shall ensure that respondent banks have KYC/AML policies and procedures in place and apply enhanced 'due diligence' procedures for transactions carried out through the correspondent accounts.

title: Originator and Beneficiary Information for Wire Transfers
description: All cross-border wire transfers shall be accompanied by accurate, complete, and meaningful originator and beneficiary information.
source_clause: i. All cross-border wire transfers shall be accompanied by accurate, complete, and meaningful originator and beneficiary information as mentioned below:

title: Wire Transfer Information Requirements
description: The ordering RE shall ensure that all cross-border and qualifying domestic wire transfers contain required and accurate originator information and required beneficiary information.
source_clause: The ordering RE shall ensure that all cross-border and qualifying domestic wire transfers {viz., transactions as per clauses (iii) and (iv) of paragraph ‘A’ above}, contain required and accurate originator information and required beneficiary information, as indicated above.

title: Customer Identification for Non-Account Holders
description: Customer Identification shall be made if a customer, who is not an account holder of the ordering RE, is intentionally structuring domestic wire transfers below rupees fifty thousand to avoid reporting or monitoring.
source_clause: b. Customer Identification shall be made if a customer, who is not an account holder of the ordering RE, is intentionally structuring domestic wire transfers below rupees fifty thousand to avoid reporting or monitoring.

title: Retention of Wire Transfer Information
description: Complete originator and beneficiary information relating to wire transfers shall be preserved by the REs involved in the wire transfer, in accordance with paragraph 46 of the Master Direction.
source_clause: Complete originator and beneficiary information relating to wire transfers shall be preserved by the REs involved in the wire transfer, in accordance with paragraph 46 of the Master Direction.

title: Name Screening for Cross-Border Transactions
description: REs are prohibited from conducting transactions with designated persons and entities and accordingly, in addition to compliance with Chapter IX of the Master Direction, REs shall ensure that they do not process cross-border transactions of designated persons and entities.
source_clause: ii. REs’ responsibility while undertaking cross-border wire transfer with respect to name screening (such that they do not process cross-border transactions of designated persons and entities)

title: Demand Drafts and Other Instruments
description: Any remittance of funds by way of demand draft, mail/telegraphic transfer/NEFT/IMPS or any other mode and issue of travelers’ cheques for value of rupees fifty thousand and above shall be effected by debit to the customer’s account or against cheques and not against cash payment.
source_clause: Any remittance of funds by way of demand draft, mail/telegraphic transfer/NEFT/IMPS or any other mode and issue of travelers’ cheques for value of rupees fifty thousand and above shall be effected by debit to the customer’s account or against cheques and not against cash payment.

title: Information Availability for Wire Transfers
description: The ordering RE shall make the information available within three working/business days of receiving the request from the intermediary RE, beneficiary RE, or from appropriate competent authorities.
source_clause: The ordering RE shall make the information available within three working/business days of receiving the request from the intermediary RE, beneficiary RE, or from appropriate competent authorities.

title: Suspicious Transaction Reporting
description: If a transaction is found to be suspicious, STR may be filed with FIU-IND in accordance with the PML Rules.
source_clause: b. Customer Identification shall be made if a customer, who is not an account holder of the ordering RE, is intentionally structuring domestic wire transfers below rupees fifty thousand to avoid reporting or monitoring. In case of non-cooperation from the customer, efforts shall be made to establish identity and if the same transaction is found to be suspicious, STR may be filed with FIU-IND in accordance with the PML Rules.

title: Responsibilities of Intermediary RE
description: RE processing an intermediary element of a chain of wire transfers shall ensure that all originator and beneficiary information accompanying a wire transfer is retained with the transfer.
source_clause: RE processing an intermediary element of a chain of wire transfers shall ensure that all originator and beneficiary information accompanying a wire transfer is retained with the transfer.

title: Obtain and verify PAN for transactions
description: Permanent account number (PAN) or equivalent e-document thereof of customers shall be obtained and verified while undertaking transactions as per the provisions of Income Tax Rule 114B applicable to banks, as amended from time to time.
source_clause: Permanent account number (PAN) or equivalent e-document thereof of customers shall be obtained and verified while undertaking transactions as per the provisions of Income Tax Rule 114B applicable to banks, as amended from time to time.

title: Use Form 60 for non-PAN customers
description: Form 60 shall be obtained from persons who do not have PAN or equivalent e-document thereof.
source_clause: Quoting of PAN Permanent account number (PAN) or equivalent e-document thereof of customers shall be obtained and verified while undertaking transactions as per the provisions of Income Tax Rule 114B applicable to banks, as amended from time to time.

title: Verify walk-in customer identity for transactions above Rs 50,000
description: The identity and address of the walk-in customer shall be verified for transactions above rupees fifty thousand as required under paragraph 13(e) of this Direction.
source_clause: the identity and address of the walk-in customer shall be verified for transactions above rupees fifty thousand as required under paragraph 13(e) of this Direction.

title: Use AML software for third-party products
description: AML software capable of capturing, generating and analysing alerts for the purpose of filing CTR/STR in respect of transactions relating to third party products with customers including walk-in customers shall be available.
source_clause: AML software capable of capturing, generating and analysing alerts for the purpose of filing CTR/STR in respect of transactions relating to third party products with customers including walk-in customers shall be available.

title: Debit to customer account for transactions above Rs 50,000
description: Transactions involving rupees fifty thousand and above shall be undertaken only by: debit to customers’ account or against cheques;  and  obtaining and verifying the PAN given by the account-based as well as walk-in customers.
source_clause: transactions involving rupees fifty thousand and above shall be undertaken only by: •  debit to customers’ account or against cheques;  and  •  obtaining and verifying the PAN given by the account-based as well as walk-in customers.

title: Cooperative banks' 'at par' cheque facility usage
description: Cooperative Banks shall ensure that the ‘at par’ cheque facility is utilised only: for their own use, for their account-holders who are KYC complaint, provided that all transactions of rupees fifty thousand or more are strictly by debit to the customers’ accounts, for walk-in customers against cash for less than rupees fifty thousand per individual.
source_clause: (c) Cooperative Banks shall: i. ensure that the ‘at par’ cheque facility is utilised only: a. for their own use, b. for their account-holders who are KYC complaint, provided that all transactions of rupees fifty thousand or more are strictly by debit to the customers’ accounts, c. for walk-in customers against cash for less than rupees fifty thousand per individual.

title: Cross 'at par' cheques
description: Cooperative Banks shall ensure that ‘At par’ cheques issued are crossed ‘account payee’ irrespective of the amount involved.
source_clause: iii. ensure that ‘At par’ cheques issued are crossed ‘account payee’ irrespective of the amount involved.

title: Digital KYC process
description: The RE shall develop an application for digital KYC process which shall be made available at customer touch points for undertaking KYC of their customers and the KYC process shall be undertaken only through this authenticated application of the REs.
source_clause: A. The RE shall develop an application for digital KYC process which shall be made available at customer touch points for undertaking KYC of their customers and the KYC process shall be undertaken only through this authenticated application of the REs.

title: KYC application access control
description: The access of the Application shall be controlled by the REs and it should be ensured that the same is not used by unauthorized persons.
source_clause: B. The access of the Application shall be controlled by the REs and it should be ensured that the same is not used by unauthorized persons.

title: Capture live photograph of customer
description: The RE must ensure that the Live photograph of the customer is taken by the authorized officer and the same photograph is embedded in the Customer Application Form (CAF).
source_clause: The RE must ensure that the Live photograph of the customer is taken by the authorized officer and the same photograph is embedded in the Customer Application Form (CAF).

title: Appointment of UAPA Nodal Officers
description: The Ministry of External Affairs, Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Foreigners Division of MHA, FIU-IND, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) and Financial Regulators (RBI, SEBI and IRDA) shall appoint a UAPA Nodal Officer and communicate the name and contact details to the Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA.
source_clause: The Ministry of External Affairs, Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Foreigners Division of MHA, FIU-IND, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) and Financial Regulators (RBI, SEBI and IRDA) shall appoint a UAPA Nodal Officer and communicate the name and contact details to the Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA.

title: Communication of UAPA Nodal Officers' Details
description: The Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA shall maintain the consolidated list of all UAPA Nodal Officers and forward the list to all other UAPA Nodal Officers, in July every year or as and when the list is updated and shall cause the amended list of UAPA Nodal Officers circulated to all the Nodal Officers.
source_clause: The Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA shall maintain the consolidated list of all UAPA Nodal Officers and forward the list to all other UAPA Nodal Officers, in July every year or as and when the list is updated and shall cause the amended list of UAPA Nodal Officers circulated to all the Nodal Officers.

title: Updating Designated Lists
description: The Ministry of External Affairs shall update the list of individuals and entities subject to the UN sanction measures whenever changes are made in the lists by the UNSC 1267 Committee pertaining to Al Qaida and Da’esh and the UNSC 1988 Committee pertaining to Taliban.
source_clause: The Ministry of External Affairs shall update the list of individuals and entities subject to the UN sanction measures whenever changes are made in the lists by the UNSC 1267 Committee pertaining to Al Qaida and Da’esh and the UNSC 1988 Committee pertaining to Taliban.

title: Daily Verification of Designated Lists
description: The Financial Regulators will issue necessary guidelines to banks, stock exchanges/depositories, intermediaries regulated by the SEBI and insurance companies requiring them to maintain updated designated lists in electronic form and run a check on the given parameters on a daily basis to verify whether individuals or entities listed in the Schedule to the Order are holding any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services held in the form of bank accounts, stocks, Insurance policies etc., with them.
source_clause: 5.1 The Financial Regulators will issue necessary guidelines to banks, stock exchanges/depositories, intermediaries regulated by the SEBI and insurance companies requiring them - (i) To maintain updated designated lists in electronic form and run a check on the given parameters on a daily basis to verify whether individuals or entities listed in the Schedule to the Order, hereinafter, referred to as designated individuals/entities are holding any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services held in the form of bank accounts, stocks, Insurance policies etc., with them.

title: Monitoring of transactions/accounts of designated individuals/entities
description: The UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall cause to monitor the transactions/accounts of the designated individual/entity so as to prohibit any individual or entity from making any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services available for the benefit of the individuals or entities listed in the Schedule to the Order or any other person engaged in or suspected to be engaged in terrorism.
source_clause: Further, the UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall cause to monitor the transactions/ accounts of the designated individual/entity so as to prohibit any individual or entity from making any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services available for the benefit of the individuals or entities listed in the Schedule to the Order or any other person engaged in or suspected to be engaged in terrorism.

title: Immediate reporting of suspicious transactions
description: The UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall, upon becoming aware of any transactions and attempts by third party immediately bring to the notice of the DGP/Commissioner of Police of the State/UT for initiating action under the provisions of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967.
source_clause: The UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall, upon becoming aware of any transactions and attempts by third party immediately bring to the notice of the DGP/Commissioner of Police of the State/UT for initiating action under the provisions of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967.

title: DNFBPs' obligations to report designated individuals/entities
description: The Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs) are required to ensure that if any designated individual/entity approaches them for a transaction or relationship or attempts to undertake such transactions, the dealer should not carry out such transactions and, without delay, inform the UAPA Nodal officer of the State/UT with details of the funds/assets held and the details of the transaction.
source_clause: The DNFBPs are required to ensure that if any designated individual/entity approaches them for a transaction or relationship or attempts to undertake such transactions, the dealer should not carry out such transactions and, without delay, inform the UAPA Nodal officer of the State/UT with details of the funds/assets held and the details of the transaction,

title: Freezing assets of designated individuals/entities
description: If the dealers hold any assets or funds of the designated individual/entity, either directly or indirectly, they shall freeze the same without delay and inform the UAPA Nodal officer of the State/UT.
source_clause: Further, if the dealers hold any assets or funds of the designated individual/entity, either directly or indirectly, they shall freeze the same without delay and inform the UAPA Nodal officer of the State/UT.

title: Prohibition on allowing designated individuals/entities to own/operate casinos
description: The UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall advise appropriate department of the State/UT, administering the operations relating to Casinos, to ensure that the designated individuals/entities should not be allowed to own or have beneficial ownership in any Casino operation.
source_clause: The UAPA Nodal Officer of the State/UT shall also advise appropriate department of the State/UT, administering the operations relating to Casinos, to ensure that the designated individuals/ entities should not be allowed to own or have beneficial ownership in any Casino operation.

title: Reporting of designated individuals/entities by CAS members
description: The members of these institutes should also be sensitized that if they have arranged for or have been approached for incorporation/ formation/ registration of any company, limited liability firm, partnership firm, society, trust, association where any of designated individual/ entity is a director/ shareholder/ member of a company/ society/ association or partner in a firm or settler/ trustee or beneficiary of a trust or a beneficial owner of a juridical person, then the member of the institute should not incorporate/ form/ register such juridical person and should convey the complete details of such designated individual/ entity to UAPA Nodal Officer in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
source_clause: The members of these institutes should also be sensitized that if they have arranged for or have been approached for incorporation/ formation/ registration of any company, limited liability firm, partnership firm, society, trust, association where any of designated individual/ entity is a director/ shareholder/ member of a company/ society/ association or partner in a firm or settler/ trustee or beneficiary of a trust or a beneficial owner of a juridical person, then the member of the institute should not incorporate/ form/ register such juridical person and should convey the complete details of such designated individual/ entity to UAPA Nodal Officer in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

title: Implementation of UNSCR 1373 requests
description: The Ministry of External Affairs shall examine the requests made by the foreign countries and forward it electronically, with their comments, to the Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA for freezing of funds or other assets.
source_clause: 8.2 To give effect to the requests of foreign countries under the U.N. Security Council Resolution 1373, the Ministry of External Affairs shall examine the requests made by the foreign countries and forward it electronically, with their comments, to the Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA for freezing of funds or other assets.

title: Exemptions for Basic Expenses
description: Funds and financial assets or economic resources necessary for basic expenses, such as food, rent, medicines, and utility charges, are exempt from provisions, subject to notification by the MEA and absence of a negative decision within 48 hours.
source_clause: 10.1 The above provisions shall not apply to funds and other financial assets or economic resources that have been determined by the Central [designated] nodal officer of the UAPA to be:- (a) necessary for basic expenses, including payments for foodstuff, rent or mortgage, medicines and medical treatment, taxes, insurance premiums and public utility charges, or exclusively for payment of reasonable professional fees and reimbursement of incurred expenses associated with the provision of legal services or fees or service charges for routine holding or maintenance of frozen funds or other financial assets or economic resources, after notification by the MEA of the intention to authorize, where appropriate, access to such funds, assets or resources and in the absence of a negative decision within 48 hours of such notification;

title: Exemptions for Extraordinary Expenses
description: Funds and financial assets or economic resources necessary for extraordinary expenses are exempt from provisions, subject to notification by the MEA.
source_clause: (b) necessary for extraordinary expenses, provided that such determination has been notified by the MEA;

title: Allowance of Interest and Payments
description: Interest or other earnings due on accounts, and payments due under contracts, agreements, or obligations that arose prior to the date of freezing, may be allowed to accounts of designated individuals/entities.
source_clause: 10.2. The addition may be allowed to accounts of the designated individuals/ entities subject to the provisions of paragraph 10 of: (a) interest or other earnings due on those accounts, or (b) payments due under contracts, agreements or obligations that arose prior to the date on which those accounts became subject to the provisions of resolutions 1267 (1999), 1333 (2000), or 1390 (2002),

title: Request for Unfreezing of Funds
description: Individuals or entities may submit a request to the Central [Designated] Nodal Officer for UAPA for unfreezing of funds, financial assets, or economic resources that have been inadvertently frozen.
source_clause: 11.1 Any individual or entity, if it has evidence to prove that the freezing of funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services, owned/held by them has been inadvertently frozen, they shall move an application giving the requisite evidence, in writing, to the concerned bank, stock exchanges/ depositories, intermediaries regulated by SEBI, insurance companies, Registrar of Immovable Properties, ROC, Regulators o

title: Procedure for Unfreezing of Funds
description: The Central [designated] Nodal Officer for UAPA shall examine requests for unfreezing of funds, financial assets, or economic resources, and if satisfied, pass an order unfreezing the same.
source_clause: 11.3 The Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA shall cause such verification, as may be required on the basis of the evidence furnished by the individual/entity, and, if satisfied, he/she shall pass an order, without delay, unfreezing the funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services, owned/held by such applicant,

title: Communication of Compliance
description: The Central [designated] Nodal Officer for the UAPA and the Nodal Officer in the Foreigners Division, MHA shall furnish details of frozen funds and prevented entry to the Ministry of External Affairs for onward communication to the United Nations.
source_clause: Officer in the Foreigners Division, MHA shall furnish the details of funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services of designated individuals/entities frozen by an order, and details of the individuals whose entry into India or transit through India was prevented, respectively, to the Ministry of External Affairs for onward communication to the United Nations.

title: Prevention of Financing of Prohibited Activities
description: No person shall finance any activity which is prohibited under The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005 or under the United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1947 or any other relevant Act.
source_clause: Section 12A of The Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005 [hereinafter referred to as ‘the Act’] reads as under: -  12A. (1) No person shall finance any activity which is prohibited under this Act, or under the United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1947 or any other relevant Act for the time being in force, or by an order issued under any such Act, in relation to weapons of mass destruction and their delivery systems.

title: Freezing of Funds
description: The Central Government shall have power to freeze, seize or attach funds or other financial assets or economic resources owned or controlled by a person, or held by or on behalf of, or at the direction of, such person, if such person is involved in a prohibited activity.
source_clause: (2) For prevention of financing by any person of any activity which is prohibited under this Act, or under the United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1947 or any other relevant Act for the time being in force, or by an order issued under any such Act, in relation to weapons of mass destruction and their delivery systems, the Central Government shall have power to— a) freeze, seize or attach funds or other financial assets or economic resources— i. owned or controlled, wholly or jointly, directly or indirectly, by such person; or  ii. held by or on behalf of, or at the direction of, such person; or  iii. derived or generated from the funds or other assets owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by such person;

title: Notification of Nodal Officers
description: Regulators, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and Foreigners Division of MHA shall notify a Nodal Officer for implementation of provisions of Section 12A of the Act.
source_clause: 1.3 The Regulators, Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Foreigners Division of MHA shall notify a Nodal Officer for implementation of provisions of Section 12A of the Act.

title: Maintenance of Updated List of Nodal Officers
description: The CNO shall maintain an updated list of all Nodal Officers and share it with all Nodal Officers periodically.
source_clause: 1.4 The CNO shall maintain an updated list of all Nodal Officers, and share the updated list with all Nodal Officers periodically.

title: Communication of Designated List
description: The Ministry of External Affairs shall electronically communicate changes made in the list of designated individuals and entities to the CNO and Nodal Officers.
source_clause: 2.1 The Ministry of External Affairs will electronically communicate, without delay, the changes made in the list of designated individuals and entities (hereinafter referred to as ‘designated list’) in line with section 12A (1) to the CNO and Nodal officers.

title: Verification of Transactions
description: All Financial Institutions shall verify if the particulars of entities/individuals match with the particulars of the designated list and report to the CNO.
source_clause: 3.1 All Financial Institutions shall – i. Verify if the particulars of the entities/individual, party to the financial transactions, match with the particulars of designated list and in case of match, REs shall not carry out such transaction and shall immediately inform the transaction details with full particulars of the funds, financial assets or economic resources involved to the CNO by email, FAX and by post, without delay.

title: Freezing of Assets
description: The CNO shall issue an order to freeze assets under Section 12A without delay if the results of verification indicate that the assets are owned by or held for the benefit of designated individuals/entities.
source_clause: 3.3 In case, the results of the verification indicate that the assets are owned by, or are held for the benefit of, the designated individuals/entities, an order to freeze these assets under Section 12A would be issued by the CNO without delay and be conveyed electronically to the concerned RE under intimation to respective Regulators.

title: Verification of Immovable Properties
description: Registrars performing work of registration of immovable properties shall verify if the particulars of entities/individuals match with the particulars of the designated list and report to the State Nodal Officer.
source_clause: 4.1 The Registrars performing work of registration of immovable properties shall -- i. Verify if the particulars of the entities/individual, party to the transactions, match with the particulars of the designated list, and, in case of match, shall not carry out such transaction and immediately inform the details with full particulars of the assets or economic resources involved to the State Nodal Officer, without delay.

title: Freezing Assets of Designated Individuals/Entities
description: All natural and legal persons holding any funds or other assets of designated persons and entities shall, without delay and without prior notice, freeze any transaction in relation to such funds or assets and shall immediately inform the State Nodal officer.
source_clause: 5.1. All Natural and legal persons holding any funds or other assets of designated persons and entities, shall, without delay and without prior notice, freeze any transaction in relation to such funds or assets and shall immediately inform the State Nodal officer along with details of the funds/assets held, who in turn would follow the same procedure as in para 4.2 to 4.6 above for State Nodal Officer.

title: Prohibition on Financing Designated Activities
description: No person shall finance any activity related to the 'designated list' referred to in Para 2.1, except in cases where exemption has been granted as per Para 6 of this Order.
source_clause: 5.2 No person shall finance any activity related to the 'designated list' referred to in Para 2.1, except in cases where exemption has been granted as per Para 6 of this Order.

title: Monitoring Transactions of Designated Individuals/Entities
description: The State Nodal Officer shall cause to monitor the transactions / accounts of the designated individual/entity so as to prohibit any individual or entity from making any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services available for the benefit of the individuals or entities in the designated list.
source_clause: 5.3. Further, the State Nodal Officer shall cause to monitor the transactions / accounts of the designated individual/entity so as to prohibit any individual or entity from making any funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services available for the benefit of the individuals or entities in the designated list.

title: Freezing Funds or Assets by CNO
description: Where the CNO has reasons to believe that any funds or assets are violative of Section 12A (1) or Section 12A (2)(b) of the Act, he shall, by order, freeze such funds or Assets, without any delay, and make such order available to authorities, Financial Institutions, DNFBPs and other entities concerned.
source_clause: 5.4 Where the CNO has reasons to believe that any funds or assets are violative of Section 12A (1) or Section 12A (2)(b) of the Act, he shall, by order, freeze such funds or Assets, without any delay, and make such order available to authorities, Financial Institutions, DNFBPs and other entities concerned.

title: Advisories and Guidance by CNO
description: The CNO shall also have the power to issue advisories and guidance to all persons, including Fls and DNFBPs obligated to carry out sanctions screening.
source_clause: 5.5 The CNO shall also have the power to issue advisories and guidance to all persons, including Fls and DNFBPs obligated to carry out sanctions screening.

title: Obligations of Dealers of Precious Metals/Stones (DPMS) and Real Estate Agents
description: The dealers of precious metals/stones (DPMS) as notified under PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 and Real Estate Agents, as notified under clause (vi) of Section 2(1) (sa) of Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002, are required to ensure that if any designated individual/entity approaches them for sale/purchase of precious metals/stones/Real Estate Assets or attempts to undertake such transactions, the dealer should not carry out such transaction and, without delay, inform the Section 12A Nodal officer in the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).
source_clause: (i) The dealers of precious metals/stones (DPMS) as notified under PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 and Real Estate Agents, as notified under clause (vi) of Section 2(1) (sa) of Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002, are required to ensure that if any designated individual/entity approaches them for sale/purchase of precious metals/stones/Real Estate Assets or attempts to undertake such transactions, the dealer should not carry out such transaction and, without delay, inform the Section 12A Nodal officer in the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).

title: Obligations of Registrar of Societies/Firms/non-profit organizations
description: Registrar of Societies/ Firms/ non-profit organizations are required to ensure that if any designated individual/ entity is a shareholder/ member/ partner/ director/ settler/ trustee/ beneficiary/ beneficial owner of any society/ partnership firm/ trust/ non-profit organization, then the Registrar shall freeze any transaction for such designated individual/ entity and shall inform the State Nodal Officer, without delay.
