source_clause: (ii) Registrar of Societies/ Firms/ non-profit organizations are required to ensure that if any designated individual/ entity is a shareholder/ member/ partner/ director/ settler/ trustee/ beneficiary/ beneficial owner of any society/ partnership firm/ trust/ non-profit organization, then the Registrar shall freeze any transaction for such designated individual/ entity and shall inform the State Nodal Officer, without delay,

title: Freezing of funds, financial assets or economic resources
description: Any freezing action taken related to the designated list under this Order should not prevent a designated individual or entity from making any payment due under a contract entered into prior to the listing of such individual or entity, provided certain conditions are met.
source_clause: 6.3 Any freezing action taken related to the designated list under this Order should not prevent a designated individual or entity from making any payment due under a contract entered into prior to the listing of such individual or entity, provided that: (i) the CNO has determined that the contract is not related to any of the prohibited goods, services, technologies, or activities, under this Act, or under the United Nations (Security Council) Act, 1947 or any other relevant Act for the time being in force, or by an order issued under any such Act, in relation to weapons of mass destruction and their delivery systems; (ii) the CNO has determined that the payment is not directly or indirectly received by an individual or entity in the designated list under this Order; and (iii) the MEA has submitted prior notification to the UNSC or its Committee, of the intention to make or receive such payments or to authorise, where appropriate, the unfreezing of funds, other financial assets or economic resources for this purpose, ten working days prior to such authorization

title: Communication of compliance of action taken
description: The CNO and the Nodal Officer in the Foreigners Division, MHA shall furnish the details of funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services of designated individuals/entities, frozen by an order, and details of the individuals whose entry into India or transit through India was prevented, respectively, to the Ministry of External Affairs, for onward communication to the United Nations.
source_clause: 8. Procedure for communication of compliance of action taken under Section 12A: The CNO and the Nodal Officer in the Foreigners Division, MHA shall furnish the details of funds, financial assets or economic resources or related services of designated individuals/entities, frozen by an order, and details of the individuals whose entry into India or transit through India was prevented, respectively, to the Ministry of External Affairs, for onward communication to the United Nations.

title: KYC documents for eligible FPIs
description: FPIs under PIS must provide certain KYC documents, including constitutive documents, proof of address, PAN, and SEBI registration certificate.
source_clause: Annex IV KYC documents for eligible FPIs under PIS

title: Definition of Group
description: The term 'group' shall have the same meaning assigned to it in clause (e) of sub-section (9) of section 286 of the Income-tax Act,1961 (43 of 1961).
source_clause: xi. 14“Group” – The term “group" shall have the same meaning assigned to it in clause (e) of sub-section (9) of section 286 of the Income-tax Act,1961 (43 of 1961).

title: KYC Identifier
description: Know Your Client (KYC) Identifier means the unique number or code assigned to a customer by the Central KYC Records Registry.
source_clause: xii. 15“Know Your Client (KYC) Identifier” means the unique number or code assigned to a customer by the Central KYC Records Registry.

title: Definition of Non-profit organisations
description: Non-profit organisations (NPO) means any entity or organisation, constituted for religious or charitable purposes referred to in clause (15) of section 2 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961), that is registered as a trust or a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 or any similar State legislation or a company registered under section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013).
source_clause: xiii. 16“Non-profit organisations” (NPO) means any entity or organisation, constituted for religious or charitable purposes referred to in clause (15) of section 2 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961), that is registered as a trust or a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 or any similar State legislation or a company registered under section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 (18 of 2013).

title: Definition of Offline verification
description: Offline verification shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in clause (pa) of section 2 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 (18 of 2016).
source_clause: xix. 19“Offline verification” shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in clause (pa) of section 2 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 (18 of 2016).

title: Definition of Principal Officer
description: Principal Officer means an officer at the management level nominated by the RE, responsible for furnishing information as per rule 8 of the Rules.
source_clause: xxi. 21“Principal Officer” means an officer at the management level nominated by the RE, responsible for furnishing information as per rule 8 of the Rules.

title: Definition of Small Account
description: A ‘Small Account' means a savings account which is opened in terms of sub-rule (5) of rule 9 of the PML Rules, 2005.
source_clause: xx. 22A ‘Small Account' means a savings account which is opened in terms of sub-rule (5) of rule 9 of the PML Rules, 2005.

title: Definition of Transaction
description: Transaction means a purchase, sale, loan, pledge, gift, transfer, delivery or the arrangement thereof and includes: opening of an account; deposit, withdrawal, exchange or transfer of funds in whatever currency, whether in cash or by cheque, payment order or other instruments or by electronic or other non-physical means;
source_clause: xxi. “Transaction” means a purchase, sale, loan, pledge, gift, transfer, delivery or the arrangement thereof and includes: a. opening of an account; b. deposit, withdrawal, exchange or transfer of funds in whatever currency, whether in cash or by cheque, payment order or other instruments or by electronic or other non-physical means;

title: Simplified Due Diligence for SHGs
description: CDD of all the members of SHG shall not be required while opening the savings bank account of the SHG; CDD of all the office bearers shall suffice.
source_clause: 43. 129Simplified norms for Self Help Groups (SHGs) (a) CDD of all the members of SHG shall not be required while opening the savings bank account of the SHG.  (b) CDD of all the office bearers shall suffice.

title: KYC Norms for Foreign Portfolio Investors
description: Accounts of FPIs which are eligible/registered as per SEBI guidelines, for the purpose of investment under Portfolio Investment Scheme (PIS), shall be opened by accepting KYC documents as detailed in Annex IV, subject to Income Tax (FATCA/CRS) Rules.
source_clause: 45. Simplified KYC norms for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) Accounts of FPIs which are eligible/ registered as per SEBI guidelines, for the purpose of investment under Portfolio Investment Scheme (PIS), shall be opened by accepting KYC documents as detailed in Annex IV, subject to Income Tax (FATCA/CRS) Rules.

title: Maintain transaction details for third-party products
description: Transaction details of sale of third-party products and related records shall be maintained as prescribed in paragraph 46 of Chapter VII.
source_clause: 67. Selling Third party products REs acting as agents while selling third party products as per regulations in force from time to time shall comply with the following aspects for the purpose of these directions: (b)  161transaction details of sale of third-party products and related records shall be maintained as prescribed in paragraph 46 of Chapter VII.

title: Maintain records for 'at par' cheques
description: Cooperative Banks shall maintain records pertaining to issuance of ‘at par’ cheques covering, inter alia, applicant’s name and account number, beneficiary’s details and date of issuance of the ‘at par’ cheque.
source_clause: 68. At-par cheque facility availed by co-operative banks (c) Cooperative Banks shall: ii. maintain the following: a. records pertaining to issuance of ‘at par’ cheques covering, inter alia, applicant’s name and account number, beneficiary’s details and date of issuance of the ‘at par’ cheque.

title: Exemption from Provisions
description: The above provisions shall not apply to funds and other financial assets or economic resources that have been determined by the CNO to be necessary for basic expenses, including payments for foodstuff, rent or mortgage.
source_clause: 6.1. The above provisions shall not apply to funds and other financial assets or economic resources that have been determined by the CNO to be: - (a) necessary for basic expenses, including payments for foodstuff, rent or mortgage,

title: Eligible Foreign Investors
description: Eligible Foreign Investors are categorized into three categories: Government and Government related foreign investors, appropriately regulated broad based funds and entities, and all other eligible foreign investors.
source_clause: Category Eligible Foreign Investors I. Government and Government related foreign investors such as Foreign Central Banks, Governmental Agencies, Sovereign Wealth Funds, International/ Multilateral Organizations/ Agencies. II. a) Appropriately regulated broad based funds such as Mutual Funds, Investment Trusts, Insurance /Reinsurance Companies, Other Broad Based Funds etc. b) Appropriately regulated entities such as Banks, Asset Management Companies, Investment Managers/ Advisors, Portfolio Managers etc. c) Broad based funds whose investment manager is appropriately regulated. d) University Funds and Pension Funds. e) University related Endowments already registered with SEBI as FII/Sub Account. III. All other eligible foreign investors investing in India under PIS route not eligible under Category I and II such as Endowments, Charitable Societies/Trust, Foundations, Corporate Bodies, Trusts, Individuals, Family Offices, etc.

title: Repeal of Circulars
description: Certain circulars are repealed partially with the issuance of Master Direction.
source_clause: List of Circulars Repealed Partially, with the issuance of Master Direction

title: KYC Policy Compliance
description: REs shall ensure compliance with KYC Policy through specifying Senior Management, allocation of responsibility, independent evaluation, concurrent/internal audit system, and submission of quarterly audit notes.
source_clause: 8. (a) REs shall ensure compliance with KYC Policy through: (i) Specifying as to who constitute 'Senior Management' for the purpose of KYC compliance.

title: CDD for Sole Proprietary Firms
description: For opening an account in the name of a sole proprietary firm, CDD of the individual (proprietor) shall be carried out.
source_clause: 27. 84For opening an account in the name of a sole proprietary firm, CDD of the individual (proprietor) shall be carried out.

title: Monitoring of Transactions
description: The following types of transactions shall necessarily be monitored: Large and complex transactions, Transactions which exceed the thresholds prescribed for specific categories of accounts, High account turnover inconsistent with the size of the balance maintained, and Deposit of third-party cheques, drafts, etc. in the existing and newly opened accounts followed by cash withdrawals for large amounts.
source_clause: 36. Without prejudice to the generality of factors that call for close monitoring following types of transactions shall necessarily be monitored: (a) Large and complex transactions including RTGS transactions, and those with unusual patterns, inconsistent with the normal and expected activity

title: Permanent Account Number Requirement
description: REs shall obtain Permanent Account Number or equivalent e-document thereof or Form No. 60 from customers by a notified date.
source_clause: In case of existing customers, RE shall obtain the Permanent Account Number or equivalent e-document thereof or Form No. 60, by such date as may be notified by the Central Government, failing which RE shall temporarily cease operations in the account till the time the Permanent Account Number or equivalent e-documents thereof or Form No. 60 is submitted by the customer.

title: Client Identification through Professional Intermediaries
description: REs shall ensure that clients are identified when client accounts are opened by professional intermediaries on behalf of a single client.
source_clause: (a) Clients shall be identified when client account is opened by a professional intermediary on behalf of a single client.
